name: software-development
description: The software-development autoloop: the first workload definition. Unit types are the kinds of work the orchestrator may dispatch against a repository; each names the capability profile it runs under and the harness-run checks that verify it.

unitTypes.name: plan
unitTypes.description: Read the repository and produce work contracts for S3 to dispatch. Never changes the repository.

unitTypes.name: research
unitTypes.description: Answer one question about the environment — a dependency, a platform, an advisory, the project's own runtime behaviour — and report typed intelligence for S3. Read-only over the domain: its result is advice, never a commit and never a policy.

unitTypes.name: implement
unitTypes.description: Change source and tests under a work contract, in an isolated worktree, and report the result.

unitTypes.name: verify
unitTypes.description: Independently examine a unit's output against its contract and the project's invariants. Read-only.

unitTypes.name: integrate
unitTypes.description: Reintegrate a unit's branch into the base and resolve what the harness refused to resolve on its own.

unitTypes.name: close
unitTypes.description: Confirm evidence is fresh, obligations are dispositioned, and the unit may be retired. Read-only.
